info.title: Perfume Shop API
info.description:
API of the perfume shop: a public storefront (catalogue, cart, orders) and an admin back-office.
All amounts are integers in **DZD**. Error messages are in French; business-rule failures answer
**422** with `{ "message": "..." }` (stock problems add `shortages`).

## Testing the admin routes here

The real frontend signs in with a **cookie session**. For testing tools, a local-only shortcut exists:

1. Call **`POST /admin/token`** with `username` and `password` (try it right here).
2. Copy the `token` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** (or the lock icon) at the top and paste it as the Bearer token.

Everything under `/admin` then works. This endpoint answers 404 outside local development.

## Roles

`owner` can do everything. `staff` can handle orders, use the caisse (POS) and read the catalogue and
stock; every other `/admin` route answers 403 for staff.

post.description:
A perfume may have several sizes, each with its own price: e.g. 10 ml, 20 ml (poured from the
ml stock) and "Flacon complet 100 ml" (a sealed bottle counted separately).
post.summary: Create a perfume (with `variants`) or a pack (with `pack`)

delete.summary: Hides the product for good (soft delete). Refused while it belongs to a pack

post.summary:
Upload a photo (jpg, png or webp, 5 MB max). It is resized to 1200 px and stored as WebP.
The first photo becomes the product's main image

put.summary: Set the gallery order; the first id becomes the main image

get.summary: All shop settings (with defaults for the ones never saved)

put.description:
`show_unavailable`: show out-of-stock items greyed out (true) or hide them (false).
`low_stock_threshold_ml`: below this many ml a perfume counts as unavailable (default 10).
put.summary: Save settings. Send only the keys to change

free_delivery_over.description: Subtotal (DZD) from which delivery is free; `null` disables it.

post.description:
Returns each line's current price and availability, the lines that no longer exist,
and — once `wilaya_id` and `delivery_mode` are given — the delivery fee and total.
Never trust prices stored in the browser: call this before checkout.

website.description: Honeypot: must stay empty. Real clients never fill it.

action.description:
`confirm` takes the stock out, `cancel` puts it back if it was taken,
`no_answer` only counts a call attempt.

restock.description: For `return`: put the bottles back in stock?

lines.description:
Replaces all items. Variants already in the order keep their original price;
new ones use the current price.
